components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: #111111; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a3a3a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f5f3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.3); background: transparent; color: #111; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms, border-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f2; border-color: #3f5f3a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f5f3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.14); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,17,17,0.1), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(17,17,17,0.08); transition: transform 300ms, box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 22px -14px rgba(17,17,17,0.38); } .ds-card__art { aspect-ratio: 1/1; background: #f4f4f2; } .ds-card__body { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 24px 26px; } .ds-card__name { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #111; } .ds-card__meta { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #595959; } .ds-card__price { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #111; }

narrative.overview:
The page is one white field. The announcement bar is black, then the header sits transparent over a white hero whose studio photograph fades at its top and left edges, so header, headline and faces share a single surface. Below, the page alternates white and a barely-grey band (#f4f4f2), separated by hairlines, and ends in a black footer. Colour comes from photography and product art, not from the interface.

Density is generous and calm: wide section padding, thin rules, tight negative-tracked Google Sans at weight 600 for every heading. Actions are black. Red and green are rationed to single jobs so they stay legible as signals.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, grey secondary text; black bars top and bottom.
Transparent header that turns solid white with a hairline once scrolled.
Photo dissolved into the page by mask, never boxed under a nav bar.
Soft neutral shadows on cards only; everything else is flat with hairlines.
Numbered routine with a strict margin column as the page's ordered device.

rules.name: The Rationed Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is only for sale tags and the bag count; green is only for Hangul captions (plus focus affordances). If a new element wants colour, it takes ink or grey.

rules.name: The Black Action Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons are black on white and white on the black footer. No coloured CTA.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Prices and counts use tabular lining numerals at weight 600.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px hairline or a band change before reaching for a shadow; shadows belong to cards.

dos: Do keep the ground #ffffff and use #f4f4f2 only for alternating bands and product-art grounds.
Do make every primary action black with white text.
Do let photography dissolve into the white page with a mask rather than a frame.
Do keep Hangul captions in Noto Sans KR, green.
donts: Don't use red anywhere except sale/new/bestseller tags and the bag count.
Don't use green for anything beyond Hangul captions and focus/hover affordances.
Don't reintroduce warm tan, brown, wood-grain or brass surfaces; the earlier drawer-wall world is retired.
Don't box the hero photo beneath a solid nav bar.
Don't add heavy or tinted shadows; shadows stay neutral and soft.
